title: Brad Pitt’s daughter moves closer to officially dropping his surname
desc:
Brad Pitt’s daughter Vivienne is one step closer to officially removing her famous father’s surname from her legal name.
The 18-year-old has officially published a legal notice revealing her intention to change her name from Vivienne Marcheline Jolie-Pitt to Vivienne Marcheline Jolie, according to court documents obtained by People.
